name: WolfMsg
meaning: Messages handled by Wolf_HandleMessage 0x484550 (sender, id, arg). Return value in brackets where meaningful.

name: MSG_KILL
meaning: arg = WolfKillType; ignored if dead or state flag 0x2000000 (unless 0x80000000), or when attached with modelSet!=0

name: MSG_USE
meaning: from Sheep while state flag 0x10000 (0x64): accumulates +0x6D8, shows prop 5; after 0x14000 ticks -> state 0xA

name: MSG_QUERY_ACTION
meaning: from Sheep: returns 0x26 (flag 0x10000 state older than 0x3000) or 0x28 (modelSet 3)

name: MSG_PICKUP
meaning: from Sam(1)/InstantMartian(0x91)/Crane(0x52): attach to sender joint arg; iced -> state 0x4D facing 0x900; modelSet 3 -> 0x8D

name: MSG_DROP
meaning: detach; SetPosition unless arg flag bit1; iced -> 0x4B; modelSet 3 -> 0x85

name: MSG_FREEZE
meaning: grabber = sender, FB |= FROZEN (refused in state flag 0x200 states); caps speed below run

name: MSG_CINE_PLACE
meaning: arg 0: stop, SetMode(0,0), ready flag 0x80; else walk to arg[0] pos with facing arg[1] (state 0x13), optional sheep drop box arg[2]

name: MSG_CINE_END
meaning: iced -> 0x4B else DropHeld(5), ResetState, SetMode(0,0), snap to ground

name: MSG_SET_ACTION_HEADING
meaning: computes +0x6F6 along segment arg[1]->arg[2], side by Wolf position, flipped if arg[0]

name: MSG_SET_ANCHOR
meaning: modelSet 5 only: if outside radius, walk to point (state 0xC0)

name: MSG_GEYSER_OUT
meaning: DropHeld(4), state 0x1A, optional rot copy [anim ms]

name: MSG_DRAGON_BURN
meaning: DropHeld(1), SetMode(0,0x9F) (WOLF_ST_BURNT). The only senders are Dragon_SetState states 1 (0x4460aa) and 3 (0x446180), each after checking MSG_WOLF_IS_DEAD == 0. The dragon's fire makes Ralph drop what he carries.

name: MSG_AXIS_LOCK
meaning: arg 0: FB|=0x200000, arg 1: FB|=0x400000 (per frame; snaps stick heading)

name: MSG_MAGNET_PULL
meaning: from Magnet_Update to the Wolf holding the magnet: arg {caught candidate, reply}; the Wolf stores arg[0] at +0x63c

name: MSG_SET_SIZE
meaning: arg!=0 shrink to 0x155, arg 0 restore 0x400 [1 if changed]

name: MSG_SCARE
meaning: +0x706 = angle to sender, deathY 32000, state 0xDA (0xBF in set 5)

name: MSG_WOLF_CAUGHT
meaning: arg 0 grab (FB DEAD, state 0x31), 2 hit (Die 0x33), 1 Die 0x32, 3 release; modelSet 3 -> Die 0x8E

name: MSG_WOLF_IS_VISIBLE
meaning: [0 in shadow zone; 1 unless state flag 0x8000, then 0x491c55(sender,target)]

name: MSG_WOLF_TAKE_ITEM_CLASS
meaning: arg = class id: remove that item from hand/inventory [found]

name: MSG_WOLF_IS_IN_BUSH
meaning: returns modelSet == 2, and WolfModelSet 2 is WMS_BUSH (not 'carrying sheep'). Queried by DaffyLevel02_Update 0x438eea/0x438fd7

name: MSG_WOLF_SQUASH_LEAP
meaning: squashed: face away from sender, state 0xD8
